description.value: Bai Tong Thai Food is a sit-down Thai restaurant on Bernard Avenue in the heart of downtown Kelowna, offering an extensive menu of curries, noodle dishes, soups, and desserts. With 123 customer reviews highlighting generous portions, fresh ingredients, and notably warm service, it has established itself as a well-regarded local favourite. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, and also provides delivery, giving touring cyclists flexible options for a post-ride meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at baitongthaifood.com is fully functional and confirms active operation as of May 2026 based on recent reviews (latest dated May 25, 2026). The menu legend explicitly labels 'gluten free' and 'vegan' items, confirming dietary options; online ordering and customer pickup references confirm takeout. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or cycling-related amenity information appears anywhere on the website, leaving those criteria null.
